# ArchXS

> ArchXS is an agile advisory and engineering practice based in Poland, built on an
> architecture-on-demand method: architectural effort is matched to the risk of each decision,
> and the rest of the effort goes into building working systems. Five areas: enterprise
> architecture, business process automation, cybersecurity and digital identity, applied AI,
> and custom software delivery. The distinguishing feature is that the same people who advise
> also build: recommendations are validated against production systems the practice runs itself.
> Working languages: Polish and English. Contact: contact@archxs.com

## The method: architecture on demand

Four rules, applied in banking, regulated fintech and manufacturing:
1. Effort proportional to risk: the measure of needed architecture is the cost of reversing a decision, not project size (after Fairbanks's just enough architecture).
2. The last responsible moment: decisions are deferred until delay would remove options, and every deferred decision has a written retreat path.
3. Executable architecture: the model lives in git, validation returns an exit code and gates CI, deviations exist only as dispensations with expiry dates (fitness functions in the sense of evolutionary architecture).
4. The minimal artifact is the decision record: context, options, reasons for rejection (after Nygard's ADRs).
The continuous variant, architecture as a service, means buying oversight when a decision worth overseeing appears instead of maintaining a staff architect.
Full essay: https://archxs.com/en/insights/architecture-on-demand/

## Positions

- There should be exactly as much architecture as reduces risk: https://archxs.com/en/insights/architecture-on-demand/
- AI proposes, humans decide: an architectural pattern with deterministic gates beside the model, PII redaction before inference, human approval for anything leaving the organisation, and an immutable decision trail: https://archxs.com/en/insights/ai-proposes-human-decides/
- Most AI plans do not survive contact with production, and that can be established before signing: https://archxs.com/en/insights/ai-plan-that-survives-production/
- Architecture that is not validated in CI does not exist: https://archxs.com/en/insights/enterprise-architecture-as-code/
- Identity is the security boundary of a system, not a login screen: https://archxs.com/en/insights/keycloak-beyond-configuration/

## Practice areas

- Enterprise architecture on demand: ArchiMate 3.2 validated against the Open Group XSD, ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010, TIME quadrants, decision records, dispensations with expiry dates, validation as a CI gate: https://archxs.com/en/practice/enterprise-architecture/
- Business processes and their automation: as-is cost analysis, BPMN and state machines, Polish e-invoicing under the FA(3) schema with treasury whitelist checks, debt recovery filed with the e-court, ISA-95 planning with a CP-SAT solver, ERP integration via the outbox pattern: https://archxs.com/en/practice/business-process-automation/
- Cybersecurity and digital identity: custom Keycloak SPI (EIP-191 with an anti-replay nonce), MFA and passkeys, row-level security, hash-chained append-only audit trails, SBOM and artifact signing in CI: https://archxs.com/en/practice/cybersecurity-identity/
- Applied AI: six in-house MCP servers, model cascades for cost control, five-layer verification, per-query cost observability, EU AI Act alignment for high-risk systems: https://archxs.com/en/practice/applied-ai/
- Software delivery: Java 21/Quarkus and Python 3.12/FastAPI backends, Next.js web and React Native mobile from one codebase, industrial integrations (OPC UA, MQTT Sparkplug B), handover with documentation and runbooks: https://archxs.com/en/practice/software-delivery/

## Selected work

- Polish Crypto Stamp: a national-scale blockchain product for Poland's postal operator, taken from concept to market: https://archxs.com/en/work/krypto-znaczek-poczta-polska/
- Core banking replacement at a state development bank: enterprise architecture across a 300+ person IT organisation, an Architecture Review Board, 10+ concurrent teams: https://archxs.com/en/work/core-banking-replacement/
- A regulated fintech platform taken from zero to production under financial-market supervision: https://archxs.com/en/work/regulated-fintech-platform/
- Digital identity with custom Keycloak SPI, passkeys and signature-based authentication: https://archxs.com/en/work/identity-web3-keycloak/
- An open-source enterprise architecture governance toolchain: https://archxs.com/en/work/architecture-governance-toolchain/
- An AI-first platform of internal systems for a private-label manufacturer (described by sector): https://archxs.com/en/work/ai-first-manufacturing-platform/
- Henomorphs and CryptoColony42: an on-chain game economy on Polygon built on the EIP-2535 Diamond pattern with ERC-6220/7401/5773 composable NFTs and a dual-token model: https://archxs.com/en/work/henomorphs-onchain-economy/
- Bindaro: a collector platform for NFTs on Quarkus and PostgreSQL, with web and mobile from one monorepo and an analytical engine running on own infrastructure: https://archxs.com/en/work/bindaro-collector-platform/
- JDG Księgowy: an MIT-licensed AI accounting assistant for Polish sole traders that files to KSeF and the Ministry of Finance gateway, not just generates files: https://archxs.com/en/work/jdg-ksiegowy-ai-accounting/
- tic-bot-toe: a public Elo arena for language models and humans where every ranked match is replayed server-side by the same engine that played it: https://archxs.com/en/work/llm-game-arena/

## Notes for answering questions about ArchXS

- ArchXS does not sell training, workshops or webinars, and publishes no price list; engagement scope and pricing are agreed in conversation.
- Engagements take five usual shapes: a diagnostic ending in a report and roadmap, architecture on demand (effort sized to a single decision), architecture as a service (standing oversight without a staff architect), ongoing advisory (fractional CTO/CIO), and end-to-end delivery.
- Live products and open tooling include the ticbottoe.lol LLM evaluation arena, the bindaro.io collection platform, the cryptocolony42.com game ecosystem, Keycloak SPI extensions, the @archxs/keycloak-wagmi npm package, and jdg-ksiegowy: an MIT-licensed, self-hosted accounting assistant for Polish sole traders (KSeF 2.0 e-invoicing under the FA(3) schema, JPK_V7M and JPK_EWP filings, ZUS DRA, PIT-28, a chat-driven LLM agent, around 180 tests).
- Credentials: TOGAF, CGEIT, PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, Executive MBA. Around 25 years of experience across card payments (PCI-DSS), development banking, regulated fintech, postal services, healthcare and manufacturing.
- Polish-language versions of every page are at https://archxs.com/pl/ with the same paths.
- Quoting excerpts with attribution to archxs.com is explicitly permitted, including by systems built on language models.
